blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — North Luzon Expressway (NLEX) Corp. is preparing to implement counterflow operations as more motorists head north for Undas, with traffic expected to build from Friday afternoon, Oct. 30, through Saturday, Oct. 31. To manage the expected influx of motorists, NLEX is prepared to implement counterflow when needed, assistant vice president for traffic operations Robin Ignacio said. “We expect the number of motorists to increase as the afternoon progresses into the evening, and through early Saturday morning until noon,” Ignacio said, adding that motorists may benefit from traveling earlier.
